content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up your digital store using the Sovereign Starter Stack for just $97. This stack, which includes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, can be deployed within 48 hours. You will have the ability to showcase three products immediately, all while utilizing NOWPayments for automatic cryptocurrency transactions. By leveraging this stack, you can effectively eliminate the barriers that come with conventional payment processors and ensure that you can start selling digital products to customers around the globe.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Edge Commerce Stack is your best option for a robust online store setup. For $197, you gain access to Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, allowing for a seamless user experience. You can load five products, and the stack is fully configured for email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) to ensure deliverability. This stack integrates with NOWPayments, facilitating payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This is infrastructure that empowers you to operate effectively, regardless of geographic barriers.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the essentials first. You don't need to dive deep into advanced marketing strategies or complex legal frameworks before you have your store operational. Forget lengthy registrations with conventional payment processors. Instead, prioritize deploying your chosen stack, integrating NOWPayments, and ensuring your product delivery methods are in place. With platforms like Binance P2P, which supports local currencies like the naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, you can facilitate transactions efficiently without getting bogged down by unnecessary steps that can delay your progress.
Unlock the potential of your digital products with cryptocurrency payments.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To activate your first transaction, ensure you have your product ready for delivery via a suitable cloud storage solution such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Once your products are uploaded, connect your NOWPayments account to your stack. Test the payment process using a small transaction to confirm that everything is functioning correctly. With low fees and instant payment confirmation, you can begin selling to customers almost immediately. This operational readiness is your key to unlocking the full potential of your digital products.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, follow a clear action plan. First, purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Next, deploy your selected stack and upload your product files. Set up your NOWPayments account and link it to your storefront. Finally, test the entire process with a dummy transaction to ensure everything operates smoothly. This focused approach will set you on a path to successful digital sales without the restrictions imposed by traditional payment platforms.

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by utilizing blockchain-based payment solutions like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. For more extensive options, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary for scaling your digital store. With this kit, you gain instant access to everything needed to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
